svg.title: Every path returns to one point
svg.desc: A round hub is set into a low rail that crosses a square plate: the review line. In front of it three leaf-shaped loop tracks fan out; their tokens, an engineer's and two agents', are docked back at the hub, and three small teal lamps show them home. The hub's top lamp is lit magenta, and one magenta token has left through a port in its back, along the only channel past the rail.
